text: {"lessons":["Judge trades by the business and price outlook, not by whether a position is above or below my average cost; a loss alone is not a reason to sell, nor a gain a reason to hold.","Avoid reacting to short-term price moves with large, frequent reallocations; make measured decisions and keep the portfolio aligned with a long-term plan.","Protect cash and manage concentration: before adding to a position, consider the risk across all holdings rather than chasing a stock after it has risen."]}
